title: James MacLeod Planting, William MacLeod on the Tractor — Upper Brighton
description: James MacLeod is planting seed potatoes while his father, William MacLeod, drives the tractor in Upper Brighton. The days of hand planting, which belonged to an earlier era, are long gone. In the past, farmers were the backbone of the river valley, serving as centres of family life, tradition and endurance. On most mornings in those earlier times, farmers woke to the need to know the market value for their produce, highlighting how closely their daily routines were tied to both tradition and market forces.
